title: Produce every train artifact before it is consumed

facts.note: Train definition files and wagon manifest files are identifiable by kind/location in the planning tree.
Fires when a train definition or a wagon manifest is authored or changed.
Planning tasks that talk about trains moving artifacts between wagons.

values: train step artifact added, renamed or reordered
artifact definition added, renamed or removed in a wagon manifest that participates in a train
facts.note: Requires a diff-level observer over train step lists and over manifests of wagons that participate in some train (cross-file resolution of participation).

values: artifact not defined in participant wagon manifests
facts.note: Requires a detector that resolves produce/consume order and cross-references participant wagon manifests.

fires: A planner adds a train step that consumes an artifact before it has been produced.
A planner adds a train step referencing an artifact that is not defined in participant wagon manifests.
A planner removes or renames an artifact definition in a participating wagon's manifest while a train still references it.
A planner names a train artifact without the {domain}:{resource} form.
doesNotFire: Editing a wagon manifest whose wagon participates in no train.
Editing prose docs or acceptances that change neither a train's steps/participants nor a participating wagon's artifact definitions.

given: A train whose participant wagons pass artifacts between them
when: The planner authors or changes the train's steps, artifacts or participants, or changes artifact definitions in a participating wagon's manifest
then: Every artifact in the train's flow must be produced before it is consumed.
prefer: Name every flowing artifact as {domain}:{resource} matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*$ — domain starts with a lowercase letter then lowercase letters, digits, hyphens; resource starts with a lowercase letter then lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens.
Define every flowing artifact in participant wagon manifests.
Order the flow so an artifact's producer comes before its consumers.
avoid: Consuming an artifact before it has been produced.
Referencing an artifact that is not defined in participant wagon manifests.
Artifact names that do not match {domain}:{resource} (e.g. uppercase, no colon separator, leading digit, characters outside the allowed sets).
why: Artifacts are what flows between train participants, so each must exist (be produced) before use and be defined where the participating wagons declare them.
evidence: Walking the train's flow in order shows every consumed artifact was produced before it is consumed.
Every artifact referenced in the train is defined in participant wagon manifests.
verifier_detail: Term 'artifact': a domain:resource artifact in the flow. Pattern: ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*$ (domain: lowercase letter then [a-z0-9-]; resource: lowercase letter then [a-z0-9.-]).
Term rules for artifact: (1) produced before consumed; (2) defined in participant wagons.
Source sample identifiers that satisfy the pattern (dotted resources allowed): material:raw-story, scenario:material.steps, match:dilemma.current.

splitSuggestion.then: Every train artifact identifier must match {domain}:{resource} (^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*$).
Every artifact in a train's flow must be defined in participant wagon manifests.

additions.text: The source statement bundles three obligations: domain:resource naming, produced-before-consumed, and definition in participant wagon manifests. Produced-before-consumed is kept in `then`; naming and manifest definition are kept in prefer/avoid/evidence and proposed as separate conventions planner.train.artifact-naming and planner.train.artifact-defined-in-wagons.
additions.justification: Rule 2 requires a single obligation in then.

additions.text: doesNotFire situations, the wagon-manifest trigger for participating wagons, and the change/finding observers are authored, not in the source.
additions.justification: Schema requires observable activation and non-firing cases; manifest-only changes can invalidate the manifest-definition rule (S016) without a train edit.

additions.text: The source states no rationale; the why restates the source's own terms (artifacts flow between participants, must be produced before consumed and defined in participant wagons) without adding consequences.
additions.justification: Schema requires a why; kept to source-derived content only.

additions.text: Illustrative failure modes (uppercase, missing colon, leading digit) derived directly from the source pattern.
additions.justification: Makes the source pattern actionable for the planner; no new constraint beyond the pattern.
